mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in three months indicates a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate decreased by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real estate sales by more than 5% in two months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where real estate sales increased by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 2% in two months signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where industrial production decreased by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable economic environment, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the instances where CPIAUCSL remained below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decreasing unemployment rate and increasing nonfarm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both UNRATE decreased and PAYEMS increased.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising GDP and increasing retail sales signals a strengthening demand side, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both GDPC1 and RSAFS increased.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate below 1% for three consecutive months signals a supportive monetary policy, which encourages investment and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS remained below 1% for three consecutive months.
